2609.15467.title: Turkish MMLU Pro: Traceable Option Augmentation and Its Validity Limits in Turkish Multiple-Choice Evaluation
2609.15467.paper_summary: Adding answer options can lower multiple-choice scores without improving assessment validity. Turkish MMLU Pro examines this distinction using 12,000 Turkish-source questions across 58 sections. Each question retains its stem, five original options and source key, and receives five options copied from other questions in the same section. Sentence-embedding retrieval proposes candidates; a language model selects existing identifiers. Deterministic verification reconstructs all 60,000 additions. A 25-model calibration exposes scoring and generation-budget effects. Five evaluations produce source-key accuracies of 34.8%-81.4%. On 981 shared questions, one API-served model falls from 93.7% with five choices to 83.1% with ten; 102 of 115 lost correct responses select borrowed options. The decrease is 24.4 percentage points on heuristically flagged negative stems and 5.9 points elsewhere. A completed human-checked audit of 200 sampled questions, with undocumented reviewer tool use, yields 47 and 31 multiple-answer judgments across the two record sets, 25 of the latter unresolved. These records support concern about ambiguity, while their dependence and incomplete reviewer-method documentation limit validation. Because order and labels also change, the paired comparison measures augmentation as implemented. The contribution is a traceable construction and an analysis of its validity limits, not evidence that lower ten-choice scores measure knowledge better.
2609.15467.paper_summary_zh: 添加答案選項可能會降低多選題的分數，而不會提高評估的有效性。土耳其 MMLU Pro 使用 12,000 道土耳其來源的問題，涵蓋 58 個部分，來檢視這一區別。每個問題保留其題幹、五個原始選項和來源關鍵，並從同一部分的其他問題中獲得五個複製的選項。句子嵌入檢索提出候選者；一個語言模型選擇現有的標識符。確定性驗證重建所有 60,000 個新增項。25 個模型的校準揭示了評分和生成預算的影響。五次評估產生了 34.8%-81.4% 的來源關鍵準確率。在 981 道共享問題中，一個 API 服務的模型從五個選擇的 93.7% 降至十個選擇的 83.1%；115 道問題中有 102 道失去正確回答選擇了借用的選項。在啟發式標記的負題幹上，下降幅度為 24.4 個百分點，而在其他地方為 5.9 個百分點。一項對 200 道抽樣問題的完整人為檢查審計，未記錄的審查工具使用，產生了兩組記錄中 47 和 31 個多重回答判斷，其中 25 個後者尚未解決。這些記錄支持對模糊性的擔憂，而它們的依賴性和不完整的審查方法文檔限制了驗證。因為順序和標籤也會改變，配對比較度量作為實施的增強。這項貢獻是一個可追蹤的構建和其有效性限制的分析，而不是證據表明較低的十選擇分數能更好地測量知識。
